ov: About 110 species of small desert rodents from Africa, India and Asia, including jirds and sand rats. Most are active by day and eat both plants and animals. The pet gerbil is the Mongolian gerbil, kept in the English-speaking world since 1954.
len: 15–30 cm, including a tail about half that length
rg: Dry regions of Africa, India and Asia; the Mongolian gerbil lives in China, Mongolia and Russia.
df: Seeds of grasses, leaves, bulbs and herbs; pets also eat fruit and vegetables.
fx: A Mongolian gerbil family shares a central burrow with 10 to 20 exits.
The name gerbil means "little jerboa", though jerboas are not closely related.
